one_line: Defiant Delhi Sultanate general who led a deadly charge against the Chagatai Mongols at Kili in 1299 CE.

appearance.age_look: Mid-30s to early 40s, tall and athletic with a soldier’s build and battle-hardened posture.
appearance.face: Oval face with a strong jaw, medium warm-brown North Indian complexion, straight nose, trimmed moustache with a short boxed beard, a faint vertical scar on the left cheek, thick dark brows, and a default expression of intense focus edged with restrained defiance.
appearance.hair: Dark brown-black hair, tied into a short, neat warrior’s knot at the back of the head, sides kept tidy; a steel conical helmet with a slightly flared brim, mail aventail covering neck and sides, and a plain dark-red cloth turban-wrap wound around the base of the helmet.
appearance.costume: Era-accurate late 13th-century Delhi Sultanate armour: over a knee-length quilted coat (zabhun) of muted indigo-blue cotton with faint vertical stitching, he wears a polished steel mail hauberk reaching mid-thigh with three-quarter sleeves; beneath, a long-sleeved off-white cotton tunic and loose dark-olive cotton trousers tucked into mid-calf brown leather boots; a broad brown leather belt with a simple rectangular brass buckle cinches the coat, carrying a small knife and pouch; over the armour, a narrow deep-crimson wool sash is tied at the right hip with its ends hanging; forearms are wrapped with brown leather bracers; no extravagant decoration, just a few small brass studs at the shoulders and a subtle geometric border in dull gold thread along the hem of the quilted coat.
appearance.signature: A slightly curved single-edged talwar-style sword with a plain steel blade, simple crossguard, and dark-brown leather-wrapped hilt, worn in a dark-brown leather scabbard with minimal brass fittings and usually shown drawn in his right hand, held in a ready low-guard stance.

ref_desc: Zafar Khan is a tall, athletic, warm-brown-complexioned Delhi general with an oval face, cheek scar, moustache and short beard, dark hair in a warrior’s knot under a steel conical helmet with red turban-wrap, wearing indigo quilted coat, steel mail, off-white tunic, dark-olive trousers, brown boots, crimson sash, leather bracers and belt, and wielding a plain steel talwar in a brown scabbard with an indigo, crimson, olive, steel, and brown palette.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of Zafar Khan, a late 13th-century Delhi Sultanate general at Kili: he is in his late 30s, tall and athletic, with an oval face, warm-brown North Indian complexion, strong jaw, straight nose, thick brows, a faint vertical scar on his left cheek, and a trimmed moustache with a short boxed beard, his default expression intense and defiant. His dark brown-black hair is tied into a short warrior’s knot, mostly hidden under a steel conical helmet with a slightly flared brim, a mail aventail over his neck, and a plain dark-red cloth wrap wound around the helmet’s base. He wears era-accurate armour: a knee-length indigo-blue quilted coat with vertical stitching, a polished steel mail hauberk over it reaching mid-thigh, and beneath these an off-white long-sleeved cotton tunic and loose dark-olive trousers tucked into mid-calf brown leather boots. A broad brown leather belt with a simple brass buckle cinches his waist, holding a small knife and pouch, and a narrow deep-crimson wool sash is tied at his right hip with its ends hanging; his forearms are protected by brown leather bracers, and the quilted coat has a subtle dull-gold geometric border at the hem with a few small brass studs on the shoulders, but no flashy ornament. Show him with his signature weapon: a slightly curved single-edged talwar-style sword with a plain steel blade, simple crossguard, and dark-brown leather-wrapped hilt, its brown leather scabbard hanging from his belt in some views but in the main front view drawn and held in a low ready stance in his right hand. Present front, side, and back views to clearly show his face, helmet with red wrap, layered indigo quilted coat and steel mail, off-white tunic, dark-olive trousers, brown boots, crimson sash, leather bracers and belt, with the palette dominated by indigo blue, deep crimson, dark olive, steel grey, and brown leather tones.
